sources.snippet: Distilled Voyage ModernBERT Cross-Encoder for UK Statutory Retrieval A ModernBERT-based cross-encoder fine-tuned for re-ranking UK legislation passages. This model distills knowledge from the proprietary Voyage rerank-2 API, providing a fully open-source alternative for statutory information retrieval.
